nd team,

What Redwood will do (high-level):
- Effective date: April 15, 2027 (your requested date).
- Seats: we will pro-rate the unused portion of the 5 seats removed. That will be calculated as (monthly seat price * 5) * (days remaining in billing cycle / days in billing cycle).
- Add-on: remove storage add-on effective April 15 and pro-rate any prepaid portion likewise.
- Credit delivery: we will issue a credit note (preferred) and apply it to the next invoice; if you need a cash refund we can arrange that once the amendment is signed.

What we need from you:
1) Signed amendment or a DocuSign confirmation authorizing the seat reduction and add-on removal (I9ve drafted an amendment and attached a working copy).
2) VAT certificate or VAT ID so our billing team can determine whether to zero-rate under reverse charge (EU rules) or charge VAT if required.
3) Confirmation if you prefer a credit note applied to the next invoice, or a refund to the card on file / bank transfer.

Estimated timeline: once we receive the signed amendment and VAT proof, Laura
nd team will calculate the precise credit and issue CN-2027-78 within 48 business hours.

Hi Elena / Vanessa,

Thanks 99for the details. Based on the current plan and list prices I9ve done a preliminary calculation:
- Monthly seat price (net): 999999999999€620.00 total for the 5 seats (net) across the month.
- Prorated credit for seats removed effective 2027-04-15 (16 days remaining of a 30-day cycle): credit = (5 seats * seat unit price) * (16/30) = preliminary credit of €1,240.00 (net).
- Storage add-on proration pending exact add-on SKU; estimate +€180.00 credit.

We will:
1) Generate credit note CN-2027-78 for the combined proration (seats + storage) and apply it to the next invoice.
2) If the last invoice was already paid and you prefer a cash refund, we can issue a refund to the original payment method once the signed amendment is received.

VAT handling: to apply reverse-charge (zero-rate on our invoice) we require:
- Valid EU VAT ID (VAT number) + a VAT registration certificate (PDF).

Please attach Vendexa_VAT_2027-04-12.pdf with the VAT certificate and confirm PO-VE-7782 on the amendment. Once we have the signed amendment and VAT cert we9ll lock in CN-2027-78 and create updated invoice INV-2027-1054 reflecting the credit.

ETA: 48 business hours from receipt of signed amendment + VAT document.
